purpose: Trigger the named action through the source Button. All six emphasis variants and eight sizes share native action semantics; icon sizes still require an explicit accessible name. Native form submit/reset semantics follow the selected type and form, not a synthetic value event.

decisions.scope: Sufficient source-bound React reference description; no certification of every consumer or native platform.
decisions.normalizedProtocol: SCXML events project source callbacks/native interactions. Send entries document the observed callback and are not additional DOM dispatches. The adapter supplies isCanceled after the source callback transaction. Controlled SET_VALUE/SET_CHECKED props remain authoritative.
decisions.visual: Native FIG observations and DTCG values remain visual truth. React styles may differ; no unverified pixel equivalence is assumed.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Action controls size intrinsically from content and semantic height/padding; no imported sample width is imposed. Source CVA emphasis/size classes are actual runtime variants. Focus/hover/disabled are native states. Icon-only squares center a 16px glyph with zero CSS padding: the native 32px square/16px glyph and conflicting 10px horizontal auto-layout padding are retained in evidence, not converted into a shrinking/clipping constraint. Rounded shape is an explicit caller className, not an invented upstream prop.
